in_sanskrit.name: Devata
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who shines, the radiant one, the deity, the god.

in_hindi.name: देवता
in_hindi.long_meaning: देव (god) के रूप में शोभन, प्रभावशाली और पूज्य व्यक्ति या प्रकार।

in_tamil.name: திருத்தவன்

in_telugu.name: దేయోదేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేయోదేశ (deity, god), దేవోదేశ (deity, god), దేవేశ (lord, master)

in_marathi.name: Deity
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God or Divine Being
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deity हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hinduism, a deity is a supernatural being worshipped as a god or goddess. Deities are believed to have control over various aspects of life, and are invoked to seek blessings, protection, and guidance.
